50	## Pricing Structure
51	
52	All pricing follows **per-person tiered rates by group size**, in IDR. Larger groups → lower per-person price.

113	## Standard Inclusions (all 15 packages)
114	
115	1. **Private transport** — AC MPV (1–3 guests) · Toyota Hiace minibus (4–9 guests) · Hiace + MPV (10–11 guests) — fuel, tolls, parking included
116	2. **Dedicated crew** — driver-guide (1–3 guests) · professional driver + escort guide (4–11 guests) · licensed local site guides at key locations
117	3. **All entrance fees and permits** to attractions
118	4. **Mineral water** — daily supply
119	5. **Full pick-up to drop-off assistance**
120	6. **Complimentary JVTO travel T-shirt** (1 per participant)
121	7. **Meals as stated in itinerary** (minimum: breakfast all packages)

138	> Helmets at Madakaripura Waterfall are **not a JVTO inclusion** — they are provided by the local waterfall site management at the canyon entrance. JVTO guides accompany guests through the approach (wading, slippery stones, narrow canyon passages). The local site team handles safety equipment on-site. **Do NOT list helmets as a JVTO-provided item for any Madakaripura route.**
139	
140	## Standard Exclusions (all 15 packages)
141	
142	- International / domestic flights
143	- Tips for drivers and guides (at guest discretion)
144	- Personal expenses — snacks, souvenirs, laundry (recommend ≥ IDR 500,000/person)
145	- Meals not stated in itinerary
146	- Travel insurance (optional but recommended)
147	- Indonesian VISA (if applicable)

155	| 10–11 guests | 1 × Toyota Hiace + 1 × MPV (seating and luggage) | Additional driver for second vehicle; escort guide travels with main group |
156	
157	**Bromo 4WD Jeep**: max ≈4 guests per jeep for comfort and safety; additional jeeps arranged for larger groups.
158	
159	## Booking Flow (6 steps)
160	
161	1. **Inquiry via WhatsApp** — message +6282244788833 with dates, group size, preferred package
162	2. **Package confirmation** — confirm package slug, pick-up point, special requirements
163	3. **Price quotation** — confirmed per pricing table for your group size
164	4. **Deposit payment** — 20% of total, card only via JVTO secure checkout
165	5. **Voucher issuance** — e-voucher issued with full trip details; pre-trip guide shared
166	6. **Tour execution** — private pick-up at confirmed time; full itinerary per voucher
167	
168	## Payment Rules
169	
170	- **Standard deposit**: 20% of total booking value (card via secure JVTO link)
171	- **Close-departure rule**: if Day 1 is within 14 days, JVTO may require up to 100% full payment
172	- **Card balance deadline**: no later than 5 days before Day 1
173	- **Bank wire / Wise balance deadline**: no later than 3 days before Day 1
174	- **Cash at JVTO office**: only if approved in writing in advance
175	
176	## Cancellation Policy
177	
178	| Window | Outcome |
179	|---|---|
180	| **≥ 48h before Day 1** | 100% of eligible booking value → Lifetime Travel Credit (no expiry, transferable, may be gifted/sold) |
181	| **< 48h before Day 1** | Fully forfeited. No Travel Credit. |
182	
183	**Cash refund is not available for guest-initiated cancellation.** The Travel Credit mechanism replaces it.
184	
185	**Closure policy**: If an official closure or route restriction affects the trip, JVTO offers a safe alternative route, reschedule option, or destination-fee adjustment per the confirmed booking context. See [[sources/ssot-v6]] §7_3 weather closures + [[destinations/mount-bromo]] Plan-B framework.
186	
187	## Rescheduling
188	
189	- **≥ 48h before Day 1**: one reschedule for the same package, subject to availability and seasonal/supplier cost difference
190	- **< 48h before Day 1**: handled case-by-case — may be treated as cancellation depending on committed supplier costs
191	
192	## Free-of-Charge (FOC) Group Incentive
193	
194	JVTO **direct bookings only** (website + WhatsApp). Not applicable to GetYourGuide, Booking.com, or other third-party platforms.
195	
196	| Paying pax | FOC seats | Additional benefit |
197	|---|---|---|
198	| 18 pax | 1 FOC | — |
199	| 35 pax | 2 FOC | — |
200	| 50 pax | 3 FOC | + 5% discount for entire group |
201	
202	Rules:
203	- "Pax" = paying guests only. FOC slot(s) do not count toward paying threshold.
204	- 5% group discount at the 50+ tier applies to the total package price for all paying guests.
205	- FOC applies to same package, same dates as the group booking.
206	- Must be agreed in writing during booking confirmation.
207	- Direct bookings only (website + WhatsApp). Not applicable to GetYourGuide, Booking.com, or other third-party platforms.
208	
209	## Anti-Fraud Policy
210	
211	- Use only official JVTO website, WhatsApp, email, payment links, and listed bank accounts (see [[overview]] §contact)
212	- JVTO **never** asks for full card numbers, CVV codes, online banking passwords, or OTP codes via chat or email
213	- Pause and verify through official WhatsApp or email before paying if any account number, link, or contact looks different
214	
215	## Student Pricing (ISIC)
216	
217	JVTO is an official ISIC provider (ID 259268 — verifiable at https://www.isic.org/discounts/?providerId=259268). Verified international students with a valid ISIC card receive student pricing. See [[credentials/trust-signals]].

8	# JVTO Operational Facts
9	
10	*Practical, citable facts from the live knowledge base ([[sources/db-export-2026-05]]). Use in AEO answers, FAQ copy, and chatbot responses.*
11	
12	---
13	
14	## Temperatures
15	
16	| Destination | Temperature range | When |
17	|---|---|---|
18	| Mount Bromo | 5–15°C (41–59°F) | Pre-dawn sunrise slot |
19	| Kawah Ijen | 10–15°C (50–59°F) | Midnight departure + crater rim |
20	
21	Both destinations require warm layers — layering recommended over single thick garment. See [[sources/jvto-travel-guide-en]] §6 packing guidance.
22	
23	---
24	
25	## Estimated Travel Times (key segments)
26	
27	| Route | Estimated time |
28	|---|---|
29	| Surabaya → Bromo (Cemoro Lawang) | ~3 hours |
30	| Ijen (Paltuding) → Surabaya | 5–6 hours |
31	| Tumpak Sewu → Bromo | 3–4 hours |
32	| Bali → Ijen (Banyuwangi side) | 5–7 hours |
33	
34	*These are operational estimates. Actual time varies with traffic, weather, and ferry schedule.*
35	
36	---
37	
38	## Arrival & Departure Timing Guidelines
39	
40	- **Day 1 latest pick-up**: 16:00 WIB (4:00 PM) — later pick-ups compress transfer time on the first night
41	- **Last-day flight recommendation**: depart no earlier than 18:00 WIB (6:00 PM); 20:00 WIB is safer for contingencies
42	- These guidelines apply to all packages starting or ending in Surabaya
43	
44	---
45	
46	## Customer Support Hours
47	
48	- **Daily availability**: 08:00–22:00 WIB (GMT+7)
49	- **WhatsApp**: +62 822-4478-8833
50	- **Email**: hello@javavolcano-touroperator.com
51	
52	---
53	
54	## Ijen Closure Schedule
55	
56	- **Regular closure**: First Friday of every month — Ijen crater is closed to visitors
57	- **Additional closures**: issued by BBKSDA East Java based on volcanic gas levels and safety assessments
58	- JVTO follows official BBKSDA closure announcements; no bypass of restrictions
59	- For scheduled closure dates, check bbksdajatim.org
60	
61	---
62	
63	## Ijen Practical Facts
64	
65	- **Trolley ojek**: A man-powered cart/porter service is available at extra cost for guests who need assistance on the ascent or descent — not a JVTO inclusion, arranged on-site
66	- **Health screening location**: Nurse visits guest's hotel the evening before the hike (Bondowoso / Banyuwangi area)
67	- **Trek difficulty**: Moderate — ~1.5–2 hours each way; steep rocky trail
68	- **Gas mask**: Provided by JVTO as standard inclusion on all Ijen-relevant packages
69	- **No Valid QR Code = No Crater Zone Access** (per BBKSDA SE.1658/KSA.9/2024)
70	
71	---
72	
73	## Bromo Practical Facts
74	
75	- **Milky Way stargazing**: Available on overnight packages departing at ~02:00 WIB (weather permitting)
76	- **Horse riding at crater**: Optional, extra cost, arranged on-site (not a JVTO inclusion)
77	- **Luggage during sunrise**: Main luggage stays at hotel; guests carry only a daypack for the jeep sequence
78	- **Yadnya Kasada festival**: Annual Tengger Hindu ceremony at Pura Luhur Poten (caldera floor) — date varies (lunar calendar). Bromo access may be restricted or heavily crowded. JVTO activates Plan-B SOP for bookings during this period.
79	
80	---
81	
82	## Waterfall Facts
83	
84	**Tumpak Sewu:**
85	- Steep, wet trail with fixed ropes and handholds on canyon descent
86	- Water shoes strongly recommended (grip on river rocks)
87	- Helmets provided — see `> Contradiction` note in packages-overview (helmets are local site management provision, not JVTO-supplied per SSOT canonical)
88	
89	**Madakaripura:**
90	- Canyon approach: wading through stream, narrow passages, wet stones
91	- You WILL get wet — waterproof bags and a change of clothes essential
92	- Helmets provided by local site management (NOT a JVTO inclusion per [[products/packages-overview]] §madakaripura-caveat)
93	
94	---
95	
96	## Tour Customization Policy ("Micro-customization")
97	
98	JVTO allows micro-customizations that don't alter the primary route or duration:
99	- ✅ Twin beds instead of double bed
100	- ✅ Hotel room category upgrade (may cost extra)
101	- ✅ Adding optional on-site activities (horse riding at Bromo, trolley ojek at Ijen)
102	- ✅ Adjusting meal plans within operational limits
103	- ❌ Unbundled / transport-only services — not offered (end-to-end quality control policy)
104	- ❌ Significant route changes that alter primary destination sequence
105	
106	---
107	
108	## FOC (Free of Charge) Group Policy — Full Terms
109	
110	| Paying pax | FOC seats | Additional benefit |
111	|---|---|---|
112	| 18+ | 1 FOC | — |
113	| 35+ | 2 FOC | — |
114	| 50+ | 3 FOC | **+ 5% discount for entire group** |
115	
116	At the 50+ pax tier, the entire group receives a 5% discount on the total package price in addition to 3 FOC seats. Source: [[sources/db-export-2026-05]] `knowledge_bases.group-benefits-foc` — confirmed canonical.
117	
118	---
119	
120	## Dietary Accommodation
121	
122	JVTO accommodates: vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free diets. Must be declared at booking — cannot be confirmed on arrival. Source: [[sources/db-export-2026-05]] `knowledge_bases.special-dietary-needs`.
123	
124	---
125	
126	## Money Exchange Guidance
127	
128	Downtown money changers have better rates than airports. JVTO does not earn referral from any money changer and is not responsible for exchange rates. Practical note to share during pre-trip briefing.
129	
130	---
131	
132	## Partial Tours / Transport-Only
133	
134	Not offered. JVTO policy: no unbundled transport-only or partially customized services. End-to-end quality control is the operational model. Guests seeking "driver only" or "car rental" should use a different provider. Source: [[sources/db-export-2026-05]] `knowledge_bases.partial-tours-transport-only`.
135

137	
138	## Trust Anchors
139	
140	This page supports **C3** (All-inclusive clarity — guests know what's included/excluded) and **C1** (Safety-led operations — closure SOP, screening protocol). Use facts from this page to answer operational queries without re-reading raw sources.

8	# JVTO WhatsApp Rules Engine
9	
10	> Dokumen ini adalah **logika eksekusi murni**. Tidak ada penjelasan filosofi.
11	> Untuk konteks & alasan, baca dulu -> [[ops/2026-05-14-whatsapp-operations-playbook]].
12	> Audiens: AI yang menjalankan classifier/router, David yang membangun sistem, Inan/staf yang perlu rujukan cepat.
13	
14	---
15	
16	## STEP 1 — Receive Message
17	
18	**Input** (dari webhook WA Pro CRM):
19	```
20	{
21	  number_key,         // identifikasi nomor JVTO mana yang menerima
22	  from,               // nomor pengirim (628xxxx@s.whatsapp.net)
23	  body,               // teks pesan
24	  type,               // conversation | imageMessage | audioMessage | etc
25	  media_url,          // jika ada
26	  timestamp
27	}
28	```
29	
30	**Action:** simpan ke `wa_messages` dengan `direction=in`. Jangan respond apa pun di step ini.
31	
32	---
33	
34	## STEP 2 — Identify JVTO Number (Inbox Router)
35	
36	Lookup `number_key` ke tabel:
37	
38	| number_key | Inbox | Default Channel |
39	|---|---|---|
40	| (kunci nomor 1) | `customer` | tergantung Step 3 |
41	| (kunci nomor 2) | `b2b_partner` | `window` |
42	| (kunci nomor 3) | `internal_ops` | `vendor_crew` |
43	
44	**Jika number_key tidak dikenal:** log error, alert Inan, stop.
45	
46	---
47	
48	## STEP 3 — Identify Channel (Phone Number Lookup)
49	
50	Hanya berlaku untuk inbox = `customer`. Untuk inbox lain, channel sudah ditentukan di Step 2.
51	
52	Cek `from` dalam urutan berikut. **Pakai first-match**, jangan teruskan.
53	
54	| Urutan | Lookup | Jika ketemu, channel = |
55	|---|---|---|
56	| 1 | `klook_bookings.guest_phone` WHERE `tour_date >= today() - 30` | `klook` |
57	| 2 | `bookings.customer_phone` WHERE `status='active'` AND `tour_date BETWEEN today() AND today()+90` | `jvto_post_booking` |
58	| 3 | `bookings.customer_phone` WHERE `tour_date < today() - 14` | `jvto_returning` |
59	| 4 | Tidak ada match | `jvto_inquiry` |
60	
61	**Output:** set `wa_conversations.channel`.
62	
63	---
64

359	## HARD RULES (Never Cross These)
360	
361	Sistem AI **tidak boleh pernah** melakukan hal berikut tanpa otorisasi manusia:
362	
363	1. **Quote price.** Kalau intent berhubungan dengan harga, **selalu** escalate ke Sam atau pakai template fixed dari `wa_templates` yang sudah di-approve.
364	2. **Confirm room availability** untuk vendor. Hanya manusia yang baru saja cek kapasitas vendor yang boleh.
365	3. **Change booking date.** Hanya Inan/Sam yang otorisasi.
366	4. **Change booking pax.** Sama seperti di atas.
367	5. **Process refund** atau cancellation. Selalu escalate ke Sam.
368	6. **Make promises** yang tidak ada di template (mis. "kami akan tambahkan...", "untuk Anda gratis...").
369	7. **Reply to complaints** secara otomatis. Selalu escalate.
370	8. **Send anything to B2B (Window)** tanpa approval Inan/Sam.
371	9. **Reply to messages with attachments** (gambar tiket, paspor, dokumen) — selalu escalate karena kemungkinan konteks penting.
372	10. **Reply when sentiment negatif terdeteksi** — escalate ke Inan/Sam.
373	11. **Reply ke nomor yang tidak terdaftar di Step 3 lookup** untuk inbox `b2b_partner` atau `internal_ops`.
374	12. **Reply outside language coverage** — kalau bahasa selain ID/EN/MS dan confidence rendah, escalate.
375	
376	Setiap pelanggaran = sistem stop dan escalate.
